title: Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2025)
eligibility: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Proficiency in C++, Java, or Python; strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.
description: Work on real-world projects alongside Google engineers, developing scalable software solutions and gaining industry experience.

title: Chevening UK Government Scholarship 2025
eligibility: International students from Chevening-eligible countries with at least 2 years of work experience.
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, monthly stipend, travel expenses)
qualification: Bachelor's degree, leadership potential, English language proficiency.
description: Fully funded master's degree scholarship allowing future global leaders to study at top universities across the UK.

title: Junior Frontend Developer (React)
eligibility: Open to early-career developers globally with strong JavaScript/TypeScript skills.
qualification: Degree in Computer Science or equivalent self-taught portfolio demonstrating React and UI work.
description: Help build and maintain web interfaces for Ubuntu and open-source enterprise products across global remote teams.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the United Kingdom pursuing a full-time postgraduate degree at Cambridge.
salary: Fully Funded (£20,000/year stipend, tuition fees, airfare)
qualification: Outstanding academic record, leadership capacity, and commitment to improving the lives of others.
description: Postgraduate scholarship supporting outstanding international applicants to study at the University of Cambridge.

title: Associate Data Analyst
eligibility: Recent graduates or early career professionals with 0-2 years of business intelligence or analytics experience.
qualification: Bachelor's in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, or CS; proficiency in SQL and Power BI.
description: Analyze user behavior, build automated telemetry dashboards, and drive business decisions for Microsoft Cloud services.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide interested in fundamental computer science concepts.
description: An entry-level course teaching algorithmic thinking and problem-solving using C, Python, SQL, HTML/CSS, and JavaScript.
